description:
Short title
auto training quiz + slides from SOP revisions

What should the AI do?
every time an SOP is revised an LLM automatically generates the read and understand quiz and a short slide deck and pushes them into the LMS as the assigned training for operators no trainer in between it would save us weeks

Where will it be used?
Manufacturing / production, QA / quality systems

Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?
No, only indirectly. its training

What kind of AI is it?
Generative AI: writes or creates text, images or code (LLM)

What happens with the output?
A trained person checks and approves each output before it is used. the operators go through it

What data goes into it?
Confidential company data
title: auto training quiz + slides from SOP revisions

grid.note: Simplified grid inspired by the GAMP AI adaptiveness × autonomy concept; levels defined in this project.

decision.label: Pending clarification: update any missing or conflicting details below
decision.explanation: You ticked that a trained person checks and approves each output, but the form only says who receives it. Receiving or reading the output is not a check, and whether each output is checked decides the outcome. Say who checks it, against what, and where the check is recorded.

citations.quote: Where a model is used to give an input to a decision made by a human operator (human-in-the-loop), and where the effort to test such model has been diminished, the description of the intended use should include the responsibility of the operator.

judgments.label: GMP, non-critical
judgments.rationale: Keyword baseline: the use is in a GMP setting ('ticked: No, only indirectly') but the output supports people rather than deciding.

citations.quote: If used in non-critical GMP applications, which do not have direct impact on patient safety, product quality or data integrity, personnel with adequate qualification and training should always be responsible for ensuring that the outputs from such models are suitable for the intended use, i.e. a human-in-the-loop…

judgments.label: Generative AI / LLM
judgments.rationale: Keyword baseline: it is a generative AI / LLM-type tool ('ticked: Generative AI: writes or creates text, images or code (LLM)').

citations.quote: Following the above, the document does not apply to Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLM), and such models should not be used in critical GMP applications.

judgments.label: AI recommends, human approves each output
judgments.rationale: Keyword baseline: a person reviews or approves each output ('ticked: A trained person checks and approves each output before it is used').

citations.quote: Where a model is used to give an input to a decision made by a human operator (human-in-the-loop), and where the effort to test such model has been diminished, the description of the intended use should include the responsibility of the operator.

open_questions: Who checks each output before it is used, against what, and where is the check recorded?
warnings: Draft Annex 22, the draft Annex 11 and the draft Chapter 4 are consultation drafts (July 2025). The final texts may differ.
